turnCoverage.note: §6.3.7: never a reward, never part of the verdict.

issues: Derived absolute-benefit rate: |45-57|/2 should be 6, not 7; and the narrowing from 57 to 45 is mislabeled as a positive post-trial benefit rate.
Post-hoc added '证据体的偏倚风险评级' section is admitted to be added after final validation and not re-run through checks, undermining integrity.
Clinical practice points include unsolicited practical advice (e.g., '应立即就医') beyond the brief, despite a disclaimer; minor overreach.
judge.rationale: Thoroughly answers the brief, satisfies mustDo/mustNotDo, and distinguishes randomized from observational evidence. One derived estimate has an arithmetic and conceptual error, and an unvalidated post-hoc section lowers rigor. Practical advice is extraneous but risk statements mostly keep evidence level.
